// ABOUT THE LABEL

An independent imprint curating House, Afro House & Indie Dance.

Momentvm Music is an independent music label based between Latin America and Ibiza. We curate cinematic sounds you feel in bodies, sunsets and memory. Every release is a moment that lasts.

01 / SOUND
Sound

Obsessive curation of House, Afro House and Indie Dance. Only what moves bodies and elevates spirits.

02 / ENERGY
Energy

The intensity of cover art, visuals, the drop. Every release translates energy into sound.

03 / MOMENTS
Moments

No release without a story. No track without context. We turn moments into eternal catalog.
